notes.title: Terrible Game Dev Award Goes To....
notes.notes: So my last update actually broke steam's ability to find the game's exe, and it took me this long to notice.  Terribly sorry, been working on game jam's to polish my skills....   (This should lead to better content and fewer bugs on later releases.)   New tiles and obstacles have been added for the next batch of levels, hopefully they will be out soon.

notes.title: Update notes for Jan 13
notes.notes:
This build lays the framework for future levels to be implemented, but the actual content is bug fixes.

[list]
[*] Levels can no longer be restarted during the victory animation giving the speedrun time of 0 seconds.
[*] Jump inputs are now properly buffered out of a dash giving the player a 100 millisecond cushion.
[*] Attempted to fix crashes on collecting followers. (Gems)  Let me know if you still experience this.
[/list]
